import z3
import itertools
print(z3.__version__)
n = 23
print("n=",n)
s = z3.Solver()
E = {(i,j): z3.Bool(f'e_{i}_{j}') for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n)}
for v in range(n):
    inc = [E[(min(v,w), max(v,w))] for w in range(n) if w != v]
    deg = z3.Sum([z3.If(e, 1, 0) for e in inc])
    s.add(deg >= 3)
    s.add(deg <= 6)
for k in range(3,7):
    num_cons = 0
    for verts in itertools.combinations(range(n), k):
        possible_edges = [E[(min(a,b),max(a,b))] for a,b in itertools.combinations(verts,2)]
        sum_edges = z3.Sum([z3.If(e,1,0) for e in possible_edges])
        s.add(sum_edges <= k-1)
        num_cons +=1
    print(f"For k={k}, added {num_cons} constraints")
print("Formula built, now checking...")
res = s.check()
print(res)
